I received an AI response to a question about using wah pedals without the Jimi Hendrix mod. I am attaching the response below.

The Experience Jimi Hendrix™ expansion was officially discontinued on April 30, 2026 and is no longer available for purchase. I'm not able to share information about future product plans, but any announcements would come through Positive Grid's official channels — subscribing to the newsletter at positivegrid.com is the easiest way to stay in the loop.

For wah on Spark 2: the J.H. Legendary Wah from that pack was the only built-in wah option in the Spark app, so that route isn't currently available if you missed the April 30 cutoff.

The good news is that a traditional hardware wah pedal works perfectly in your signal chain — just connect guitar → wah pedal → Spark 2 input. You get full wah control right in the middle of your pedalboard with no app dependency needed.

I would like someone to tell me a good model of wah to use with the Spark control X and any limitations it may have as far as mixing, as well as if a similar expansion to the Hendrix mod will be released?
Ai slop

My original complaint was that the Positive Grid Neo wireless transmitter does not fit the Ibanez S series guitars. This is a known issue.

Can you point customers to the straight extension you have a picture of on your website. My attempts to source a suitable female-make 1/4 Jack extension have been unsuccessful.

Cheers

I have a Spark, it's a great little amp…but I would have hoped using Ai that the Reactor would have multi tap delay or maybe the possibility of using two delays in the chain, to get the Hank Marvin sound I would like (and a lot of others)…..same for the omission at the moment of a pitch shifter etc, for a classic 12 string sound from the 60s….I have a pedal made by Digitech for a lovely 12 string sound, so it can be done, but would rather have a preset on the Reactor for ease of use….maybe these can be future updates ( maybe model a Meazzi valve echo unit for the Hank sound) and maybe model a Rickenbacker 12 string……At the moment, without these features, I doubt if I will buy over my Spark…..There are more to amps than hundreds of overdrive and distorted Rock and Metal tones.
